+"""Closed receipt and file-identity guards shared by finalization entry points."""
+
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import yaml
+from common import (
+    BASE,
+    DOSSIER,
+    PACKAGE,
+    PY,
+    ROOT,
+    TARGET,
+    TARGET_SHA,
+    bind,
+    check_inputs,
+    input_config,
+    inventory,
+    read,
+    relative,
+    sha,
+    verify,
+)
+
+NATIVE_STEPS = ("validate", "save", "history", "validate-history", "check")
+ARCHIVE_NAMES = {
+    "adoption": "actual-adoption.json",
+    "gates": "execution.json",
+    "preservation": "preservation.json",
+    "tested_inputs": "tested-inputs.json",
+    "page_qa": "page-qa.json",
+    "visual_observation": "visual-observation.json",
+    "root_assessment": "root-assessment.json",
+    "display_approval": "approved-node-display-delta.json",
+    "display_assessment": "node-display-assessment.json",
+}
+
+
+def rooted(path, relative_path=None):
+    """Require exact path identity and prohibit a symlink at any rooted component."""
+    path = Path(path)
+    if relative_path is None:
+        relative_path = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
+    rel = relative(relative_path)
+    assert str(path) == str(ROOT / rel), (path, rel)
+    assert not path.is_symlink(), path
+    assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in path.parents if p.is_relative_to(ROOT)), path
+    assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve()), path
+    return path
+
+
+def destination_set(destinations, allowed_root):
+    paths = [rooted(ROOT / relative(value)) for value in destinations]
+    assert len(paths) == len(set(paths)), "Duplicate archive destination"
+    for path in paths:
+        assert path.is_relative_to(allowed_root), path
+        assert not path.exists(), path
+        assert not any(parent in paths for parent in path.parents), "File/ancestor collision"
+        assert not any(parent.exists() and not parent.is_dir() for parent in path.parents)
+    return paths
+
+
+def expected_archive_entries(cfg):
+    rows = []
+    for key, name in ARCHIVE_NAMES.items():
+        if key in cfg:
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "destination": DOSSIER + "/final-gates/" + name,
+                    "original": cfg[key],
+                    "mode": "exact",
+                }
+            )
+    for receipt in read(cfg["gates"]["path"])["receipts"]:
+        for stream in ["stdout", "stderr"]:
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "destination": DOSSIER
+                    + "/final-gates/"
+                    + receipt["name"]
+                    + "."
+                    + stream
+                    + ".json",
+                    "original": receipt[stream],
+                    "mode": "lossless_utf8",
+                }
+            )
+    for item in cfg.get("additional_artifacts", []):
+        rows.append(
+            {
+                "destination": DOSSIER + "/final-gates/" + relative(item["name"]),
+                "original": item["original"],
+                "mode": item["mode"],
+                **{
+                    key: item[key]
+                    for key in ["projection_description", "full_original"]
+                    if key in item
+                },
+            }
+        )
+    assert len({row["destination"] for row in rows}) == len(rows)
+    return rows
+
+
+def verify_archive_plan(path, applied=False):
+    plan = read(path)
+    assert plan["status"] == "actual_receipts_verified_pending_root_archive"
+    assert plan["root"] == str(ROOT)
+    verify(plan["config"])
+    cfg = input_config(plan["config"]["path"])
+    adoption, gates, preservation, assessment, tested = check_inputs(cfg)
+    expected = expected_archive_entries(cfg)
+    assert len(plan["mappings"]) == len(expected)
+    assert [
+        {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "prepared"} for row in plan["mappings"]
+    ] == expected
+    destinations = [row["destination"] for row in expected]
+    if not applied:
+        destination_set(destinations, ROOT / DOSSIER / "final-gates")
+    else:
+        assert len(set(destinations)) == len(destinations)
+        for value in destinations:
+            rooted(ROOT / relative(value))
+    for row in plan["mappings"]:
+        verify(row["original"])
+        verify(row["prepared"])
+        if row["mode"] == "lossless_utf8":
+            wrapped = read(row["prepared"]["path"])
+            assert wrapped["serialization"] == "lossless-utf8-json"
+            assert wrapped["content_status"] == "unchanged_original_bytes_encoded_as_text"
+            assert wrapped["original"] == row["original"]
+            assert wrapped["text"].encode("utf-8") == Path(row["original"]["path"]).read_bytes()
+        else:
+            assert row["mode"] in {"exact", "credential_header_projection"}
+            assert row["prepared"]["sha256"] == row["original"]["sha256"]
+    return plan, cfg, adoption, gates, preservation, assessment, tested
+
+
+def verify_archive_receipt(path):
+    archive = read(path)
+    assert archive["status"] == "archived"
+    verify(archive["plan"])
+    plan, cfg, adoption, gates, preservation, assessment, tested = verify_archive_plan(
+        archive["plan"]["path"],
+        applied=True,
+    )
+    expected = {row["destination"]: row for row in plan["mappings"]}
+    assert len(archive["files"]) == len(expected)
+    seen = set()
+    for row in archive["files"]:
+        rel = relative(row["relative_path"])
+        assert rel in expected and rel not in seen
+        seen.add(rel)
+        rooted(row["path"], rel)
+        verify(row)
+        assert (row["bytes"], row["sha256"]) == (
+            expected[rel]["prepared"]["bytes"],
+            expected[rel]["prepared"]["sha256"],
+        )
+    assert seen == set(expected)
+    return archive, plan, cfg, adoption, gates, preservation, assessment, tested
+
+
+def execution(binding, directory, label, arguments):
+    """Validate the exact native invocation and its two complete bound streams."""
+    expected_path = Path(directory) / (label + "-execution.json")
+    assert binding["path"] == str(expected_path)
+    verify(binding)
+    receipt = read(expected_path)
+    assert receipt["command"] == [PY, "-B", *arguments]
+    assert receipt["cwd"] == str(ROOT)
+    assert receipt["environment"] == {
+        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
+        "UV_NO_SYNC": "1",
+        "PYTHONPATH": str(ROOT / "src") + ":" + str(ROOT),
+    }
+    assert type(receipt["exit_code"]) is int and receipt["exit_code"] == 0
+    start = datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["started_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    end = datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["finished_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    assert start.tzinfo is not None and end.tzinfo is not None and start <= end
+    for stream in ["stdout", "stderr"]:
+        assert receipt[stream]["path"] == str(Path(directory) / (label + "." + stream))
+        verify(receipt[stream])
+    return receipt
+
+
+def verify_assembly(path):
+    assembly_path = Path(path)
+    assembly = read(assembly_path)
+    assert assembly["status"] == "assembled_pending_native_validation_and_root_save"
+    assert assembly["maintained_writes"] is False
+    assert assembly["target"] == bind(ROOT / TARGET)
+    assert assembly["target"]["sha256"] == TARGET_SHA
+    verify(assembly["archive_receipt"])
+    archive, plan, cfg, adoption, gates, preservation, assessment, tested = verify_archive_receipt(
+        assembly["archive_receipt"]["path"],
+    )
+    assert assembly["config"] == plan["config"]
+    verify(assembly["config"])
+    assert assembly["review"]["path"] == str(assembly_path.parent / "completed-review.yaml")
+    verify(assembly["review"])
+    doc = yaml.safe_load(Path(assembly["review"]["path"]).read_bytes())
+    assert doc["reviewer"]["independence"] == "self_review"
+    assert doc["review_id"] == assembly["review_id"]
+    assert doc["source"]["git_revision"] == BASE
+    input_list = assembly_path.parent / "native-inspection-inputs.json"
+    assert assembly["inspection_inputs"] == bind(input_list)
+    paths = read(input_list)
+    assert isinstance(paths, list) and len(paths) == len(set(paths))
+    from assemble_review import RUBRICS
+
+    required = (
+        set(tested)
+        | set(RUBRICS)
+        | {
+            "pages/records/MetaCyc_LYXMET-PWY.html",
+            "pages/downloads/nodes.tsv",
+            "pages/downloads/edges.tsv",
+        }
+        | {row["relative_path"] for row in archive["files"]}
+    )
+    assert set(paths) == required - {TARGET}
+    receipt = execution(
+        assembly["inspect_receipt"],
+        assembly_path.parent,
+        "inspect",
+        [
+            str(PACKAGE / "inspect_with_inputs.py"),
+            "--input-list",
+            str(input_list),
+            "--targets",
+            str(PACKAGE / "targets.yaml"),
+        ],
+    )
+    inspection = read(receipt["stdout"]["path"])
+    assert inspection["status"] == "inspection_only"
+    assert doc["source"] == inspection["source"] and doc["targets"] == inspection["targets"]
+    inputs = inspection["source"]["inputs"]
+    assert len(inputs) == assembly["source_inputs"] == len(required)
+    assert {row["path"] for row in inputs} == required
+    for item in inputs:
+        assert sha(rooted(ROOT / relative(item["path"]))) == item["sha256"]
+    return assembly, doc, cfg, adoption, receipt
+
+
+def history_arguments(doc, review_path):
+    details = (
+        "Added the exact accepted full L-lyxose record (111 edges"
+        ", 66 references, ten endpoint qualifiers), "
+        "original-derived canonical authority delta and reviewed bounded native adapters. "
+        "Independent original science, scientific successor and canonical audit are retained; "
+        "this finalization is author-prepared self-review packaging. "
+        "Issues 438/439 are accepted source-backed corrections, not yet a claim of GitHub closure. "
+        "Actual maintained gates, preservation and static QA are bound in the new saved review "
+        + doc["review_id"]
+        + ". Native saved review: "
+        + str(review_path.relative_to(ROOT))
+        + ". "
+        "No source-exhaustion or public-release licensing readiness claim. "
+        "PR/CI/merge and branch cleanup remain root-owned."
+    )
+    return [
+        "scripts/new_history_record.py",
+        "--kind",
+        "record",
+        "--slug",
+        "l-lyxose-degradation",
+        "--target-root",
+        "data/pathways",
+        "--event",
+        "CREATE",
+        "--outcome",
+        "changed",
+        "--summary",
+        "Add source-qualified L-lyxose degradation with accepted review corrections",
+        "--details",
+        details,
+        "--actor-name",
+        "codex",
+        "--actor-type",
+        "ai_agent",
+        "--agent-tool",
+        "codex",
+        "--issue",
+        "438",
+        "--issue",
+        "439",
+    ]
+
+
+def verify_native_completion(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    completion = read(path)
+    assert completion["status"] == "saved_review_and_history_checked"
+    assert set(completion["actual_receipts"]) == set(NATIVE_STEPS)
+    verify(completion["assembly"])
+    assembly, doc, cfg, adoption, inspect_receipt = verify_assembly(completion["assembly"]["path"])
+    assert completion["review_id"] == doc["review_id"]
+    review_path = rooted(ROOT / "reviews/structured" / doc["review_id"] / "review.yaml")
+    markdown = rooted(review_path.parent / "review.md")
+    assert completion["canonical_yaml"] == bind(review_path)
+    assert completion["canonical_markdown"] == bind(markdown)
+    assert yaml.safe_load(review_path.read_bytes()) == doc
+    history_path = rooted(completion["history"]["path"])
+    assert history_path.is_relative_to(ROOT / "history/records/l-lyxose-degradation")
+    verify(completion["history"])
+    commands = {
+        "validate": [
+            "scripts/record_review.py",
+            "validate",
+            assembly["review"]["path"],
+        ],
+        "save": [
+            "scripts/record_review.py",
+            "save",
+            "--content",
+            assembly["review"]["path"],
+        ],
+        "history": history_arguments(doc, review_path),
+        "validate-history": ["scripts/validate_history.py", str(history_path)],
+        "check": ["scripts/record_review.py", "check", "--base", BASE],
+    }
+    prior_finish = inspect_receipt["finished_at"]

+from common import PACKAGE, PY, ROOT, bind, now, read, write

+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    ap.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--stage", choices=["initial-lint", "fix-format", "final"], required=True)
+    args = ap.parse_args()

+    env = {**os.environ, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "UV_NO_SYNC": "1"}
+    files = sorted(str(p) for p in PACKAGE.glob("*.py"))
+    checks = []
+    if args.stage == "initial-lint":
+        checks.append(("lint", [PY, "-B", "-m", "ruff", "check", "--no-cache", *files]))
+    elif args.stage == "fix-format":
+        checks.append(
+            ("lint-fix", [PY, "-B", "-m", "ruff", "check", "--no-cache", "--fix", *files])
+        )
+        changed = [
+            str(PACKAGE / p)

+                "common.py",
+                "lineage.py",
+                "assemble_review.py",
+                "run_native.py",
+                "apply_archive.py",
+                "archive_completion.py",
+                "bind_final_files.py",
+                "seal_completion.py",
+                "test_lineage.py",
+                "validate_v2.py",
+            ]
+        ]
+        checks.append(("format", [PY, "-B", "-m", "ruff", "format", "--no-cache", *changed]))
+    else:
+        checks += [

+            ("original-guards", [PY, "-B", str(PACKAGE / "test_guards.py")]),
+        ]

+            "apply_archive",
+            "assemble_review",
+            "run_native",
+            "archive_completion",
+            "bind_final_files",
+            "seal_completion",
+            "inspect_with_inputs",

+            checks.append(("help-" + name, [PY, "-B", str(PACKAGE / (name + ".py")), "--help"]))
+        checks.append(("lint", [PY, "-B", "-m", "ruff", "check", "--no-cache", *files]))
+        checks.append(

+                "compile",
+                [
+                    PY,
+                    "-B",
+                    "-c",
+                    "from pathlib import Path; "
+                    + "paths=list(Path("
+                    + repr(str(PACKAGE))
